articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 Opus with Extended Context Window of 2 Million Tokens
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude 4 Opus, its most capable model to date, featuring a 2 million token context window and significantly improved reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on complex coding, mathematics, and scientific research benchmarks. Anthropic claims the model also incorporates new constitutional AI techniques that reduce harmful outputs by over 40% compared to its predecessor.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves Human-Level Performance on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini 2.5 Ultra has surpassed human-average scores on the USMLE, UK Medical Licensing Assessment, and several European medical boards. The multimodal model can analyze medical imaging, patient histories, and lab results simultaneously to assist in diagnostic workflows. The announcement has reignited debate among medical professionals about the appropriate role of AI in clinical decision-making.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its agentic offerings with Operator Pro, a new enterprise-tier platform that allows businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents capable of managing multi-step workflows across third-party software. The platform integrates natively with Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft 365, enabling agents to handle procurement, HR onboarding, and financial reporting tasks with minimal human oversight. Early enterprise customers report up to 60% reduction in administrative workload during beta testing.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Under Open License, Sparks Community Excitement
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a 70-billion parameter model that rivals several closed-source competitors on standard benchmarks while being freely available for commercial use. The release includes optimized quantized versions designed to run efficiently on consumer-grade GPUs, lowering the barrier for independent researchers and startups. Within 48 hours of release, the model had been downloaded over 800,000 times on Hugging Face.

articles.title: New RAG Framework 'HyperRAG' Claims 3x Retrieval Accuracy Improvement Over Standard Approaches
articles.summary: Researchers from Carnegie Mellon University and Stanford have published a paper introducing HyperRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that combines hierarchical indexing with dynamic query decomposition. In benchmarks across legal, scientific, and financial document corpora, HyperRAG outperforms traditional RAG pipelines by a significant margin, particularly on multi-hop reasoning questions. The open-source implementation is already available on GitHub and has attracted significant attention from the enterprise AI community.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine Against Undisclosed Firm for High-Risk AI Violations
articles.summary: The European AI Office has levied a €45 million fine against an unnamed financial services company for deploying a high-risk AI credit-scoring system without proper conformity assessments or human oversight mechanisms as required under the EU AI Act. The ruling marks the first significant enforcement action since the Act's full provisions came into force earlier this year. Legal experts say the decision signals that regulators are prepared to act aggressively against non-compliant deployments across all sectors.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Real-Time Voice and Vision Capabilities for Custom Agent Builds
articles.summary: Microsoft has updated Copilot Studio with native real-time voice and computer vision modules, allowing enterprise developers to build multimodal AI agents without writing custom integrations. The new capabilities include live screen analysis, natural language voice commands with sub-300ms latency, and seamless handoff between voice and text modalities. The update is being rolled out to all Copilot Studio subscribers throughout the week.

articles.title: Researchers Warn of 'Prompt Injection 2.0' Threat Targeting Long-Context Agentic AI Systems
articles.summary: A team of security researchers from MIT and ETH Zurich has published findings describing a new class of adversarial attack dubbed 'Prompt Injection 2.0,' which exploits the long context windows of modern agentic AI models to hide malicious instructions deep within retrieved documents. Unlike earlier prompt injection techniques, these attacks are significantly harder to detect and can persist across multi-turn agent sessions. The paper calls on model developers to implement dedicated context integrity verification layers before deploying agents in sensitive environments.
